<thought>From the 13C NMR data, the distinct chemical shift values are 139.25, 134.60, 129.00, 128.30, 49.40, 26.10, and 11.40 ppm. Duplicate peaks (129.00 and 128.30 each appear twice) represent equivalent carbons. Thus there are 7 unique carbon environments.</thought>
